name: Zaavan
title: Descendant of Seir the Horite
summary: Zaavan (also spelled Zavan) was a son of Eser, who was a son of Seir the Horite. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the Horite clan leaders who lived in the land of Seir (Edom) before the Edomites took over the area. His historical significance lies in showing the original peoples of the Edom region.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Zaavan is listed as a son of Eser in the genealogy of the Horites who lived in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Horite Clan Leaders in Seir
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Zaavan's family, were the original inhabitants of the mountainous land of Seir before Esau's descendants drove them out.

keyEvents.title: Eser as a Horite Chief
keyEvents.description: Zaavan's father Eser is mentioned among the Horite chiefs who ruled in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Zaavan is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles as part of the Horite lineage through Eser, son of Seir.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Seir as a starting point
keyEvents.description: Seir the Horite had several sons, including Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan, who were clan leaders in the region.
